precepts.why:
Elihu tells Job: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.” This was Elihu speaking to Job prophetically about times to come. Are we not oppressed today? Yes.

Moses wrote the same thing in the curses: “And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore”. That is what Elihu was talking about. The oppressed crying out by reason of the arm of the mighty is Israel under the curses, oppressed and spoiled evermore.

Solomon said it too: “So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power”. They have the guns, the nuclear weapons, the court system; they have it all, and we have nothing. That is the arm of the mighty.

But the Most High “looked down from the height of his sanctuary” to “hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death”. We are the prisoner: sons of God in a weak body, ruled and dominated by a wicked race of people and subject to their laws. We groan waiting for “the redemption of our body”. We want our godhood back, rulership back, dominion back, to reign on this planet like we once did.

precepts.text: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry; they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty. Our people cry out constantly because of the arm of the mighty.
precepts.point: Thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway. Always. There will never be a time in America when all black and brown people, the Israelites, are successful and ruling, and that is why we need a saviour.
